v3.m2: sha256(bodyWithSignature) — body bytes without second-signature blocks and without multisignatures, WITH the first signature
v3.signingHash: sha256(body) — bytes without any signature; signed by the secp256k1 key (Schnorr legacy) → json.signature
v3.block: alg u8 || sig_len u16 LE || signature; alg 0 = secp256k1 Schnorr over m2 (64 B), alg 1 = ML-DSA-44 over m2 with ctx "sth-pq-v1" (2420 B), ascending alg order
v3.registration: type 1 payload = alg u8 (1) || pk_len u16 LE (1312) || publicKey; blocks = [proof of the current second key, signature of the new key]
v3.fee: static fee + feePerByte(10000) × Σ(3 + sig_len): +24 230 000 per ML-DSA block, +670 000 per alg-0 block
v3.firstPassphrase: this is a top secret passphrase
v3.secondPassphrase: second passphrase of the wallet (legacy secp256k1 and ML-DSA-44 key derive from the same text)
